value.rationale: The source paper naturally leaves the structure of its zero-sum three-spaces unresolved beyond their number. Degree nine is the first odd degree divisible by three within the nontrivial Welch range: a subfield F8 stabilizer appears, producing a genuinely new exceptional orbit alongside a generic orbit, unlike the earlier n=7 one-orbit situation. The complete orbit/stabilizer classification distinguishes all 1606 configurations and is useful for finite-field equivalence classification, rather than an arbitrary finite sample.
